name: Image Card
description: A Link Card with a photo above the title. The photo zooms in on hover. The whole card is one link: its title link covers it. On hover, and while keyboard focus is on a link inside it, the card shows its hover colors. Don't put a button in it.
sources: az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2365 (design-reviewed): 16px corners, 24px card padding, the 8px space below the title, the 16px space below the text, the Cloud fill and Tinta text
The arizona.edu desktop XD mockup that az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2365 implements: the 5:3 photo
az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2273 (closes #2271): 18px body text; az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2286: its 28px line height
Arizona Bootstrap 5.2: the title's 30px line height (.h5)
az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2365 (design-reviewed): .card.bg-cloud.hover: the hover colors, and their 300ms ease-out fade
The AZ Digital UX Design System Figma file's Card component (2026-10-29): Style Cloud, with Default and Hover states

root.description: The card. It shows its hover colors on hover, and while keyboard focus is on its title link or another link inside it (focus-visible), so keyboard users see the same change.

border.width.$description: Card border width: none, since the fill sets the card apart from the page. In a forced colors (high contrast) mode, which removes fills, draw a 1px border instead so the card keeps its edge.

border.radius.$description: Card corner radius. An image takes the card's top corners, and stays inside them when it zooms.

transition.duration.$description: How long the card's fill and text colors take to change on hover and with keyboard focus. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion; the colors still change.

transition.easing.$description: Easing for the card's color changes: ease-out. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

image.description: A photo at the top of the card, in its top corners. It zooms in on hover and with keyboard focus, inside the card's corners. The photo fills its shape, cropped if it has to be.

aspect-ratio.width.$description: Image shape: its width, against aspect-ratio.height. The image is 5:3.

aspect-ratio.height.$description: Image shape: its height, against aspect-ratio.width. The image is 5:3.

transition.duration.$description: How long the image takes to zoom in, and back out. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion; the image still zooms.

transition.easing.$description: Easing for the image zoom: ease. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

scale.$description: How much the image grows on hover: 8% larger. Implementations use it as transform: scale().
How much the image grows while keyboard focus is on the card's link: the same as on hover.

padding.x.$description: Space between the card's left and right edges and its content.

padding.y.$description: Space between the card's top and bottom edges (or its image) and its content.

title.description: The card's heading: a link that covers the whole card. With keyboard focus, its ring is drawn in its own color, so it stands out from the fill as much as its text does.

line-height.$description: Card title line height. The space below the title is measured from this line.

margin-bottom.$description: Space between the title's line and the text below it.

text.description: The card's text, below the title.

font.size.$description: Card text size: the same as body text.

line-height.$description: Card text line height: the same as body text.

margin-bottom.$description: Space below the text, before more text, a list of links or a call to action. The last thing in a card has no space below it.

link.description: A link in the card's text, if it has one. With keyboard focus, its ring is drawn in its own color, so it stands out from the fill as much as its text does.
